governance.attested_by: miso-52 sigmoid monthly-gas-key probe 2026-07-09: the miso-51 recipe with the coal passthrough sigmoid's gas key held at the monthly (contract-repricing) level while gas units keep the daily price (fuel._gas_series)
governance.note: Identical kwargs to miso-51 (miso-49 keeper flags + gas_daily_shape[MISO] + hydro 2024-backfill/EIA-930 repin, on the re-derived measured coal sigmoid). ONE code change, zero new parameters: the sigmoid's gas key no longer takes the within-month daily HH swing — a coal fuel contract's discount posture reprices monthly, not on daily spot (one mechanism per timescale). Built to test the miso-51 hypothesis that the daily-keyed sigmoid (a) suppressed the coal-vs-gas flip days and (b) caused the C4 2024 coal-corr and C3b 2023/24 monthly-shape FAILs via coal-offer whipsaw.
governance.validation_note: Reproducible via scripts/probes/_miso52_sigmoid_monthly_key.py main. Rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin: same script, ablation mode. RESULT: the monthly key is confirmed in the offer surface (sigmoid key collapses to ~9 unique monthly values; gas units keep the daily series) but EVERY scored criterion is within noise of miso-51 — COAL_PRB +29.9/+25.1/+25.8 TWh (miso-51 +30.1/+25.1/+26.9), C4 2024 coal r=0.854 (0.856), C3b 0.278/0.289 (0.277/0.289), C3a/C3c unchanged.
governance.residuals_note: DISCOVERED RESULT — BOTH miso-51 hypotheses REFUTED (rules 1/10/11, disclosed not tuned): (a) flip days do not appear because the merit gap is too wide — the measured-f.o.b. sigmoid discounts PRB/BIT so deep (~$15-20/MWh offers) that even the deepest daily gas troughs (factors to 0.57) leave CC above coal; (b) the C4 2024 coal dispatch-corr FAIL and C3b shape FAILs are NOT daily-key whipsaw — they persist bit-for-bit under the monthly key, and C4 was already failing at miso-50 before any daily shape existed. CORRECTED ATTRIBUTION: C4/C3b regressions (vs miso-49) arrived with the sigmoid re-derive itself. The coal over-run is now demonstrated robust to five independent interventions: measured sigmoid params (miso-50), daily gas granularity (miso-51), sigmoid key timescale (miso-52), hydro completeness (miso-51), and all forcing floors off (both ablation twins). It is pure economic merit ordering. The remaining structural suspect is the sigmoid MECHANISM's premise — that committed/mustrun coal (~70% of PRB capacity in discounted tranches) bids far below delivered cost to hold merit. MISO IMM/Potomac SOM coal offer-to-cost data is the measured adjudicator: if real MISO coal offers near cost (as the SOM's competitive-conduct findings suggest), the deep-discount premise, not its parameters, is the wrong market structure for 2023-2025 MISO.
